## Deterministic checks

- FPC under-run in the lower web: PASS (need 0.250, have 0.300, margin 0.050)
- U8 relocation on F.Cu (OD-U8): INFEASIBLE — U8-F is feasible only if some module centre lies outside the display outline while the module stays on MAIN. Necessary bounds: centre <= R_main - s/2 = 18.00 mm (inscribed-circle containment) and centre > R_display = 21.95 mm (the centre is a point of the module). 18.00 < 21.95, so no F.Cu position of a 10 mm module escapes the rigid display; the lever cannot remove U8 from the governing front-gap stack (RF evidence not even reached). The earlier R_main - circumradius bound was orientation-dependent and is replaced by this valid necessary-condition pair.
- Optical window plate under 5 ATM (ATM-2, analytical model only, NOT a qualification): unsupported radius 10.600 / 12.550 mm (nominal / conservative); standoff available 0.100 mm nominal. Support bounds: clamped = optimistic/stronger-support, simply-supported = conservative/weaker-support (sizing case). 1 of 18 combinations pass the simply-supported bound; 3 more pass only the clamped bound and are CONDITIONAL ON VERIFIED CLAMPED/RESTRAINED SUPPORT (bond restraint unresolved, gated). 1 of 18 material/thickness/corner combinations pass the conservative simply-supported bound; 3 more pass only the clamped (optimistic) bound and are CONDITIONAL ON VERIFIED CLAMPED/RESTRAINED SUPPORT - the window bond restraint is unresolved and stays gated. No analytical result here is a 5 ATM qualification (ATM-Q2, X23 retained).
  - Linear small-deflection Kirchhoff plate, circular, uniform pressure. Support bounds: clamped edge = OPTIMISTIC / stronger-support bound (assumes verified edge rotation restraint); simply-supported edge = conservative / weaker-support bound and the sizing case. Outcomes are reported per support independently; a row passes only if the simply-supported bound passes. Validity limit: flagged where w/t > 0.5 (membrane stiffening then makes the linear result conservative). Analytical model with PARAMETRIC planning properties only - NOT a 5 ATM qualification; the actual window geometry, material and bond restraint remain unresolved (G2 pod concept / G3 caseback, ATM-Q2 window variant, X23) and any clamped-only pass is CONDITIONAL ON VERIFIED CLAMPED/RESTRAINED SUPPORT.
- Caseback seal band (5 ATM): R_case_inner 24.050 / 23.400; 4 reservation(s) cross the band and need separate feedthrough seals: CHG_CONTACT, VENT
- Cover rim vs provisional case inner radius: nominal fit margin 0.550 mm, residual wall -0.150 mm vs t_bezel_min 0.700; conservative fit margin -1.100 mm (G3 case co-design must grow the front aperture or the case)

## G1 verdict

**THICKNESS OWNER DECISION REQUIRED** — Stop rule (G1_BRIEF.md 4.6): no scenario is credibly <= 15.5 mm, so the G1 verdict is THICKNESS OWNER DECISION REQUIRED; the tradeoff table is presented and no requirement is weakened. OD-COVER and OD-REAR-SIDED are NOT revoked.

- Thinnest scenario: G1-K4 at 15.180 nominal / 15.670 RSS (credible: no).
- Thinnest scenario using only CREDIBLE_LATER_TASK levers: G1-K2 at 16.080 nominal / 16.525 RSS.
